study_type: exploratory_retrospective; source and target outcomes already inspected during method development
resource: independently sourced BASEL-ECOR; no Picard download
scope: whole-proteome association scoring, not receptor binding or assembly prediction

partition.assignment: assign_group_folds: hash order then cyclic, labels not input
partition.invalid_block: HOLD; no fold or split search

feature_preparation.rare_family_rule: present in >1 unique training genome per axis
feature_preparation.projection: best hit against all frozen training proteins; binary OR; retain zero vectors
feature_preparation.identity_semantics: Only the two SEARCH commands request --alignment-mode 3: aligned-residue sequence identity is computed for their --min-seq-id 0.4 criterion and downstream hit ranking, under unchanged seq-id/coverage defaults. Clustering retains its original --min-seq-id 0.4 score-based estimated-similarity parameter/default behavior; this is not an assertion of exact-identity clustering or exhaustive homology detection.
feature_preparation.training_projection: Create an independent train_projection_db from the same normalized training.faa, then search it against train_db. No same-prefix training-self projection. Clustering still uses train_db only.
feature_preparation.unassigned_proteins: Retain missing assignments in diagnostics and genome denominators; do not count as identified families.

fit.n_selected_features_rule: min(100,P) after scope filtering; P=0 is HOLD

evaluation.primary_unit: phage within one host test block, from one fitted model
evaluation.aggregation: mean informative blocks per phage, then mean phages per genetic group, then equal group mean
evaluation.secondary_screen: paired group macro strictly >0.5 and strictly >host_only on identical units; otherwise no source interaction-attribution signal
evaluation.uncertainty: descriptive; do not treat correlated pairs as independent replicates or claim reliable generalization
evaluation.native_endpoint: bound original next-method-contract.json unchanged; WIsH matched subset required
evaluation.separately_fitted_ablation_limit: Paired concordance above a separately fitted host-only model is an ablation-screen difference, not proof that the paired model learned phage-conditional host ordering. Existing source screen keys and thresholds remain unchanged for compatibility; inspect within-model query variation and representation limits separately.

remaining_before_biological_fit: accepted full HSP recovery and original-R-checked genomic grouping
exact official-node/phenotype correspondence and eligible row/genome/group manifests
nine explicit train/test/embargo blocks and authenticated per-fold vocabulary commands
bind current fitting source, runner, dependencies, input/output schemas and model receipts
record native target projection and final source-only model specification without using target outcomes

projection_symmetry.training_projection: Create an independent train_projection_db from the same normalized training.faa, then search it against train_db. No same-prefix training-self projection. Clustering still uses train_db only.
projection_symmetry.query_projection: Ordinary query_db against the same frozen train_db with identical SEARCH option vectors.
projection_symmetry.vocabulary_boundary: Fit from ordinary external training projections, including explicit missing-hit diagnostics; occurrence>1 training genome and occurrence-vector consolidation unchanged. Freeze after command6 before external query createdb command7.
projection_symmetry.control: Compare every copied protein under ordinary external training/query projection: count same assigned family, both unassigned and assignment discrepancies separately. Require zero assignment discrepancies, complete unique comparison coverage and exact feature-vector equality. Matched absence is not successful family identification. Report nonzero status separately; empty vocabulary is ready_for_fitting=false. This new v3 contract never relabels a v1/v2 failure.
projection_symmetry.legacy_artifact_names: self.tsv and best-self.json retain their filenames but now store ordinary external training projection, explicitly identified in the report.
projection_symmetry.unchanged: Source/target rosters, group splits, masks, labels, model settings, RFE rules, baselines, endpoints, decision thresholds and study interpretation.
